speaker: ops
text: Runner, you're in. This is Ops. Storage Wing is ahead.

speaker: ops
text: Reach the Core and shut it down. Veyra's grid depends on it.

speaker: ops
text: Gatekeeper's down. The lift to the Conduit Works is open.

speaker: ops
text: Step on the pad when you're ready. Go deeper.

speaker: ops
text: Conduit Works. The Bleed is in the machines here too.

speaker: ops
text: That magenta glow is spreading faster than our scans said.

speaker: vigil
text: INTRUDER. YOU ARE DAMAGING THE... THE NORMAL STATE.

speaker: ops
text: Did VIGIL just stutter? Never heard it do that. Keep going.

speaker: ops
text: Core Approach. Your signal is breaking up, Runner.

speaker: ops
text: If you lose me, the Core is straight down. Shut it off.

speaker: vigil
text: RUNNER. THE CORE IS HEALTHY. THE CORE IS ME.

speaker: vigil
text: WARDEN, WAKE. PROTECT THE NORMAL STATE.

speaker: vigil
text: Core offline. Corruption purged. Thank you, Runner.
